headline: UBS Downgrades StoneCo on Interest Rate Concerns and Cuts Price Target
summary: UBS lowered its rating on Brazilian payment processor StoneCo, citing interest rate headwinds and reducing its price target for the Nasdaq-listed shares.
why: StoneCo is a leading financial technology vendor for Brazilian merchants; its valuation reflects consumer credit conditions and interest rate expectations in Brazil.

impacts.name: StoneCo Ltd.
impacts.why: A analyst downgrade and target cut from UBS pressured StoneCo's stock price.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: StoneCo stock fell following a broker downgrade and price target reduction by UBS over macroeconomic rate risks.
